description: Analysis of healing efficiency: what worked, what was wasteful, and what architectural changes will reduce future healing cycles.

breakdown.reason: Blocked before any scenario planning. Stale denominator hash. Could have been prevented by pre-run denominator validation.
breakdown.prevention: Before each run, verify api_catalog_sha256 in denominator matches current package catalog hash. Add to preflight checklist.

breakdown.reason: 3/5 — PdfAConverter fix was incomplete (added REQUIRED but not FORBIDDEN for wrong options class). Required another run.
breakdown.prevention: When fixing a SEMANTIC_GENERATION failure, add both REQUIRED (correct pattern) AND FORBIDDEN (wrong alternatives) simultaneously.

breakdown.reason: 3/5 — Merger regression introduced by repair prompt that lacked structural REQUIRED constraints.
breakdown.prevention: Before any run with repair-prone types, ensure ALL structural patterns are REQUIRED: (not template_hints). Merger had AddInput/AddOutput as template hints — promoted to REQUIRED: resolved.

breakdown.reason: MailMerger failed due to complex constraint token. Processor attempted (1 build cycle) before API_ACCESS_PARADOX detected.
breakdown.prevention: Constraint token validation: before run, verify all REQUIRED: constraint first tokens are simple identifiers. Pre-check for API_ACCESS_PARADOX in catalog.

SEMANTIC_GENERATION_namespace.preventability: HIGH — check using directives for all fixture types at constraint design time

SEMANTIC_GENERATION_options_class.preventability: MEDIUM — explicit options class constraint at type onboarding time

REPAIR_REGRESSION.preventability: HIGH — structural pattern promotion checklist before repair

API_ACCESS_PARADOX.preventability: HIGH — pre-flight catalog check for constructors:[] + all-instance methods

if_per_type_constraints_in_yaml_from_sta.rationale: Config-driven constraints would have included PdfAConvertOptions REQUIRED from run1. FP-004 would have been prevented.

if_repair_regression_check_in_place.rationale: Automatic check that REQUIRED: constraints all still present after repair would have caught FP-005 before it became a full run failure.

if_api_access_paradox_preflight.rationale: Processor build attempt would have been skipped.

if_constraint_token_validation_pre_run.rationale: MailMerger complex token would have been caught before run1.

architectural_improvements_impact.improvement_factor: 3.5x fewer runs with full architectural improvements

healing_intelligence_roi.future_runs_protected: All future PDF+Words runs benefit from 24 constraints preventing 9 known failure patterns
healing_intelligence_roi.estimated_future_runs_saved_per_family_w: 2-3 (previously needed 5+ runs; now expected 2-3 with constraints pre-loaded)
healing_intelligence_roi.knowledge_persistence: PERMANENT — registries committed to git, loaded at session start

recommendations.recommendation: Add pre-run catalog hash validation to preflight checklist and automate in runner.py before planning phase.
Implement constraint token validation: before each run, verify all REQUIRED: constraint first tokens are simple identifiers (no spaces, no quotes).
recommendations.estimated_runs_saved: 1 per new REQUIRED constraint with complex token

recommendations.recommendation: Implement API_ACCESS_PARADOX pre-flight in type_classifier.py: skip types with constructors:[] and all is_static:false methods.
Add post-repair validation step: after each repair round, re-run all REQUIRED: constraint checks before attempting build. Catch regression before build cycle.
When adding a SEMANTIC_GENERATION fix, always add BOTH the REQUIRED: correct pattern AND FORBIDDEN: wrong alternatives in the same iteration. Never fix half the failure.
